text: Fresh coat of paint: on computers the radio now sits right next to the headline, and on phones the home page is shorter and quicker to scroll.
Arizona metal shows are now the first thing on the home page, with address, phone and directions for every show.
The Live Now bar under the banner now shows each song's band, title, year and the band's country.
Every Arizona show now lists the venue's address, a tap-to-call phone number and a Directions button.
New Follow button at the top of every page: the HeavyMusix email, Instagram, Threads, YouTube and the app in one place. The menu now has search built in and fits any screen.
Put HeavyMusix Radio on your phone or computer: tap "Get the HeavyMusix app" on the home page and it opens straight to the radio.
A cleaner home page: latest news first, quick buttons to jump to what you want, and the News page now shows 12 stories at a time.
